List run sessions for a workspace.

Args:
    workspace_id: The workspace ID to filter by.
    active_only: If True, return only active sessions.
    limit: Maximum number of results to return.
    offset: Number of results to skip.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    Paginated list of run sessions.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if workspace not found.

Create a new run session.

A RunSession tracks a series of RunRequests for a troubleshooting session.
If no name is provided and generate_name is True, a unique name will be generated.

Args:
    data: The run session creation data.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The created run session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 400 if workspace not found or name already exists.

Delete a run session.

This will also delete all associated RunRequests (cascade delete).

Args:
    session_id: The run session ID.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if session not found.

Deactivate a run session.

Sets the session's active flag to False. Inactive sessions cannot accept
new RunRequests but can still be viewed and referenced.

Args:
    session_id: The run session ID.
    data: Optional deactivation request with reason.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The deactivated run session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if session not found.
    HTTPException: 400 if session is already inactive.

Mark a run session as escalated.

Escalation flags the session as requiring human attention. This is used
for issue triage and prioritization.

Args:
    session_id: The run session ID.
    data: Optional escalation request with escalated status.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The escalated run session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if session not found.

info.name: List run sessions for a workspace

params.name: active
params.description: If set, filter to sessions whose ``active`` column matches this value (``true`` for active, ``false`` for inactive). Omit to return both.

params.name: modified__gte
params.description: Filter to sessions with modified_at >= this ISO-8601 datetime. Must include a timezone offset (e.g. ``...+00:00`` or ``...Z``); naive datetimes are rejected to avoid ambiguity against the tz-aware column.

params.name: modified__lte
params.description: Filter to sessions with modified_at <= this ISO-8601 datetime. Must include a timezone offset.

params.name: created__gte
params.description: Filter to sessions with created_at >= this ISO-8601 datetime. Must include a timezone offset.

params.name: created__lte
params.description: Filter to sessions with created_at <= this ISO-8601 datetime. Must include a timezone offset.

params.name: runrequest__runbook__name
params.description: Filter by SLX/runbook full name (e.g. workspace--short-name). Returns only sessions with at least one RunRequest for this SLX.

params.name: runrequest__runbook__name__in
params.description: Filter by multiple SLX/runbook full names (comma-separated). Returns sessions with at least one RunRequest matching any name.

info.name: Create a run session with run requests

items.docs:
Create a new run session with run requests atomically.

This endpoint creates a RunSession and associated RunRequests in a single
atomic transaction. It supports deduplication to merge requests into
existing sessions based on the source type.

**Deduplication behavior by source:**
- `direct`: No deduplication - always creates a new session
- `search`: No deduplication - always creates a new session
- `slo_alert`: Deduplication enabled (10m window by default)
- `sli_alert`: Deduplication enabled

items.docs:
Process the next step in the RunSession workflow.

This endpoint coordinates several background tasks:
1. Processes queued RunRequests that are ready to run (if any)
2. Marks relevant issues as visited
3. Triggers persona tasks if a persona is attached

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace short name.
    runsession_id: The RunSession ID.
    db_session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    StepResponse with processing status.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 4
